newsitem.title: USA: Presstek boosts production after order.
newsitem.headline: Presstek boosts production after order.

text.p: Presstek Inc said on Thursday that it is increasing its production of Pearl Direct Imaging Systems used in printing presses to an average of four per day by September 1997 after it had received additional orders.
The company, which presently makes three imaging systems per day, now has a backlog of $55 million that it expects to ship over the balance of 1997, it said.
Presstek said it has not yet negotiated the amount of certain other fees and revenues it may receive from German printing press maker Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG.
Presstek's backlog before this order could not immediately be determined. The company was not immediately available for comment.
A Presstek spokesman said the company's backlog before this order was previously $15 million.
